headline: First preliminary party vote: National ahead with 5.7% of voting places reported
body: Early preliminary figures carried by RNZ, using Electoral Commission data, show National on 31.6% of the party vote and Labour on 28.4%, followed by the Greens (12.4%), ACT (11.3%), NZ First (9.7%) and Opportunity (5.6%). These figures cover only the 5.7% of voting places that had reported, not 5.7% of votes. Preliminary results leave out special votes and will change as counting goes on. Official results are expected on 27 November.
